title: What VR Could, Should, and Almost Certainly Will Be within Two Years (Steam Dev Days 2014)
summary: Michael Abrash of Valve explains what affordable VR hardware will be capable of within a couple of years, and describes a prototype showing what that level of hardware can do.
why: Cited for his plain-language explanation of how VR convinces the brain and for resolution and pixel-density figures.
